slides.teacher_cue: New sound. Mouth slightly open, lips spread, jaw slightly lowered. Between /æ/ and /ɪ/ — not as wide as a, not as high as i. Short and clear.

slides.observation_note: Watch for vowel drift — Korean learners may produce /e/ as /æ/ or confuse it with /ɪ/.
